description:
Problem
Clearing the SMTP configuration name and saving is now reachable through the form's novalidate behavior. EmailConnectorSettings.smtp_persistence_result/2 returns a ChannelConfig changeset for non-file errors, but NotificationSmtpLive renders an EmailConfig form. A review regression test proved the entered relay value disappears after rejection. The page does not crash.

Scope and acceptance
- Preserve the EmailConfig form schema, submitted SMTP credentials, connection-name draft and Advanced/file settings for persistence-level errors.
- Project actionable persistence errors into the correct form fields, select Main for a name error, and keep tab navigation usable.
- A rejected save must leave persisted configuration unchanged. Correcting the name and saving must persist the original drafts.
- Cover blank name and representative persistence errors in the existing EmailConnectorSettings and SMTP LiveView suites; include both new and existing connections where applicable.
- Keep the existing file-error projection and cross-service boundary intact.
Action reuse: extend the existing EmailConnectorSettings save operation and error projection. Reuse the existing NodeRouter/Event route; no new Action, endpoint or tool.
Read docs/services/engine.md, DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before affected work.

Implementation prompt
Work on PR 2 in ../zaq-feat-channel-file-settings, branch feat/channel-file-settings (PR jat10/zaq#16, stacked on feat/email-capabilities). Verify current Git state and preserve other work. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Use Serena for source navigation. Implement with TDD: demonstrate the failure first, make the smallest coherent fix, then run focused regressions and mix q. Reuse existing test modules, fixtures and setup; create a test module only when no suitable owner exists, explaining why. Write original tests; do not copy tests from the old worktree or weaken existing assertions. Follow existing-test approval rules. Do not run mix precommit, commit, push or merge without fresh authorization.

comments.text: Discovery/reuse plan: real SMTP save flow is BO EmailConfig -> existing confidential email_connector_settings Event/SaveEmailConnector -> EmailConnectorSettings.persist -> ChannelConfig Repo insert_or_update -> smtp_persistence_result. Non-file persistence errors currently return ChannelConfig changesets; BO then renders the wrong schema. Extend the existing error projector to retain the submitted EmailConfig changeset, map name errors to connector_name, keep file-local error projection, and map otherwise unrenderable persistence errors to a form-level error. Phoenix.Ecto form data supports fields present in params/errors without adding a schema field, so preserve the embedded schema. BO should retain the submitted changeset before persistence so stale/archived/encryption failures also retain drafts, and render the name error in the existing field. No new Action/endpoint or authorization/encryption/atomicity changes. Original TDD in existing Engine and SMTP LiveView suites, reusing smtp_params/tabbed_smtp_params and connector fixtures: new/existing blank name, correct typed form and all drafts/errors, DB unchanged, corrected resubmission, and representative archived-selection rejection. Preserve all existing assertions and file-error cases. No commit/push/precommit.

TDD evidence: /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-red.log captured five original failures at Engine/LiveView persistence boundaries. The implementation retains EmailConfig drafts for persistence errors, projects connection-name errors to connector_name, and retains submitted drafts on archived-selection rejection. /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-green.log: 67 passing checks (1 property, 66 tests), including database reload and correction/resubmit assertions. mix q passed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-q.log). Existing browser checks remain for final validation; no precommit, commit, or push run.

Final focused validation shared with zaq-h2i.3.8: 801 checks passed (6 properties, 795 tests), /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-7-8-regressions-final.log; mix q passed. New/existing blank-name saves retain every SMTP/File draft, expose the name error on Main, reject without database changes, and persist the original drafts after correction. Archived-selection rejection also retains submit-only drafts and stored values. Existing persistence file-error projection remains covered. No existing test assertions or scenarios were modified. Required existing E2E suite is running; new consolidated feature E2E remains behind zaq-h2i.3.4/zaq-h2i.3.5. No precommit, commit, or push.

title: [zaq-h2i.3] Preserve SMTP form drafts on persistence validation errors
